author: botagas
install_msg: RoomAnnounce is a companion for Roomer. Load Roomer first and enable the Guild Presences intent for automatic game detection.
name: RoomAnnounce
short: Advertise Roomer voice channels with game metadata.
description: Creates persistent Roomer announcement controls and automatic informational game posts for monitored static voice channels.
end_user_data_statement: This cog temporarily stores Roomer and monitored channel IDs, owner IDs, detected game metadata, game announcement settings, owner-provided announcement text, and RSVP user IDs and responses. Monitored-channel records do not store participant IDs. RSVP data is removed when the game changes, its announcement or room is deleted, RSVP is disabled, or a user-data deletion request is processed.
